To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the majority of Tanzanian respondents preferred the following as the key objectives of civic education: (1) to develop a responsible citizenship, and (2) to develop tolerance and respect.

• There is a general consensus among Tanzanian citizens that civic education should aim at promoting tolerance, knowledge of citizen’s rights, patriotism, empowering citizens to question and critique, and respect to authority.
The majority of respondents (both male and female) ranked the right to information, the right to be educated and the right to be represented as the most important rights.
